program='''def transform(grid):
    n = len(grid)
    original = [list(row) for row in grid]
    clockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*original[::-1])]
    counterclockwise = [list(row) for row in zip(*original)][::-1]
    halfturn = [row[::-1] for row in original[::-1]]
    out = []
    for r in range(n):
        out.append(original[r] + clockwise[r])
    for r in range(n):
        out.append(counterclockwise[r] + halfturn[r])
    return out
'''
